description: Source code for AMR speech codec encoding functions, including initialization, reset, exit, and encoding routines for GSM/AMR encoder.

methods.name: GSMInitEncode
methods.description: Initializes the encoder state, allocates memory, and sets up necessary states for encoding.

methods.name: Speech_Encode_Frame_reset
methods.description: Resets the encoder state memory to initial conditions.

methods.name: GSMEncodeFrameExit
methods.description: Frees memory and cleans up encoder state.

methods.name: Speech_Encode_Frame_First
methods.description: Encodes the first speech frame, applying pre-processing and initial encoding steps.

methods.name: GSMEncodeFrame
methods.description: Encodes a speech frame into serial bits, applying pre-processing and main encoding routines.
